name: Wema
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) Wema Bank Plc 2025 audited annual report: consolidated statement of financial position (printed page 121, group column, 31-Dec-25 and 31-Dec-24) and the five year financial summary (printed page 247, group column). In thousands of Naira, stored here in absolute Naira. CRON 20261118: total assets, total liabilities, total equity and cash rebuilt for all five years. The stored file had FY2025 total assets of 860.4bn and a negative equity of 168.3bn; the printed totals are 5,072,310,440 and a positive equity of 620,463,321, and assets less liabilities equals equity on every year exactly.
